name: utility_seo_ga
title: Utility SEO Google Analytics
summary: Loads Google Analytics after cookie consent.
description: Loads Google Analytics (gtag.js) with the id of data_settings_seo.json, only when the visitor allows analytics in the cookie notice (require_consent, default true). Turning analytics off later disables tracking and clears the _ga cookies. Rendered in the page head by page_constructor.
